newsitem.title: USA: Craig Corp Q3 share rises.
newsitem.headline: Craig Corp Q3 share rises.

text.p: Craig Corp said on Friday it reported net earnings for the three months ended September 30, 1996 of about $1.853 million or $0.33 per share, compared to $1.6 million or $0.27 per share for the year-ago period.

The company said it reported net earnings for the nine months ended Sept 30, 1996 of about $40.419 million or $7.07 per share versus net earnings of about $3.037 million or $0.51 per share for the nine months ended Sept 30, 1995.

About $34.9 million of the net earnings for the 1996 nine-month period were attributable to its previously announced conversion of its 50 percent common stock interest in Stater Bros Holdings Inc into shares of a new class of Stater preferred stock having a stated value of about $69.4 million, the company said.
